questions.stem: 服用禁藥對其他選手並不公平，然而獎金越高，就越多人願意冒這個險。
questions.answer: Taking banned drugs is not fair to other athletes, yet the bigger the prize, the more people are willing to take the risk.
accepted_answers: Using banned drugs is unfair to other athletes, but the higher the prize money is, the more athletes are willing to take this risk.
Taking illegal drugs is not fair to other players; however, the more prize money there is, the more people are willing to take the risk.

patterns: 愈…愈…（the + 比較級, the + 比較級）

questions.stem: 一旦真相曝光，這些選手要讓球迷忘記他們所做的事，是非常困難的。
questions.answer: Once the truth is revealed, it is extremely difficult for these athletes to make fans forget what they have done.
accepted_answers: Once the truth comes out, it is very hard for these athletes to make their fans forget what they did.
Once the truth is exposed, it is extremely difficult for these players to get fans to forget what they have done.

patterns: 虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋for 人＋不定詞

1.explanation_zh: 「服用禁藥」是動作當主詞，用動名詞片語 Taking banned drugs，動詞用單數 is；「對…不公平」是 not fair／unfair to …。「然而」用 but／yet／however。「獎金越高，就越多人願意…」用 the + 比較級, the + 比較級：the higher the prize money (is), the more people are willing to …；「冒這個險」是 take the risk。
evidence: 獎金越高，就越多人願意冒這個險
1.strategy_zh: 「越 A 越 B」→ The + 比較級 + S (+ V), the + 比較級 + S + V；動作當主詞 → V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：服用禁藥／對其他選手並不公平／然而獎金越高／就越多人願意冒這個險
標的詞彙：take（服用）、drug（藥物）、fair（公平的）、other（其他的）、athlete（選手）、prize（獎金）、willing（願意的）、risk（風險）
句型框架：V-ing … is not fair to …, but the + 比較級 + S, the more + N + are willing to …

2.explanation_zh: 「一旦真相曝光」用 Once the truth is revealed／comes out（時間子句用現在式表未來）。「這些選手要…是非常困難的」：difficult 不能用人當主詞，改用虛主詞 It is extremely difficult for these athletes to …。「讓球迷忘記」是使役 make fans forget（原形動詞）。「他們所做的事」用 what 引導的名詞子句 what they have done 當 forget 的受詞。
2.strategy_zh: 「某人要做某事很難」→ It is difficult for + 人 + to V；「所＋V＋的（事）」→ what + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：一旦真相曝光／這些選手要讓球迷／忘記他們所做的事／是非常困難的
標的詞彙：truth（真相）、reveal（揭露）、athlete（選手）、make（讓）、fan（球迷）、forget（忘記）、difficult（困難的）
句型框架：Once + S + is p.p., it is extremely difficult for + 人 + to make + O + forget + what + S + have done

references: Taking banned drugs is not fair to other athletes, yet the bigger the prize, the more people are willing to take the risk.
Using banned drugs is unfair to other athletes, but the higher the prize money is, the more athletes are willing to take this risk.
Taking illegal drugs is not fair to other players; however, the more prize money there is, the more people are willing to take the risk.

patterns.label_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞（服用禁藥…）
愈…愈…（the + 比較級, the + 比較級）
patterns.frame: the + 比較級 + S (+ V), the + 比較級 + S + V

common_errors.wrong: Take banned drugs is not fair
common_errors.right: Taking banned drugs is not fair
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作「服用禁藥」當主詞要用動名詞 Taking …（或 To take …），原形動詞不能當主詞。

accepted: is not fair to other athletes
is not fair to other players

common_errors.wrong: are not fair to other athletes
common_errors.right: is not fair to other athletes
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。

common_errors.wrong: is not fair to another athletes
common_errors.right: is not fair to other athletes
common_errors.explanation_zh: another 後面接單數名詞；複數要用 other athletes。

accepted: but the higher the prize money is
however the more prize money there is
but the higher the prize money

common_errors.right: but the higher the prize money
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「越…越…」要寫成 the + 比較級 + 主詞 (+ 動詞)，比較級放在前面。

common_errors.wrong: but more higher the prize money
common_errors.right: but the higher the prize money
common_errors.explanation_zh: high 的比較級是 higher，不再加 more，前面也要有 the。

parts.zh: 就越多人願意冒這個險
accepted: the more people are willing to take the risk
the more athletes are willing to take this risk
the more people are willing to take this risk
the more people are willing to risk it

common_errors.wrong: more people are willing to take the risk
common_errors.right: the more people are willing to take the risk
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「越…越…」前後兩半都要用 the + 比較級，後半的 the 不能省略。

common_errors.wrong: the more people are willing to take the danger
common_errors.right: the more people are willing to take the risk
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「冒險」的固定搭配是 take a／the risk，不說 take the danger。

traps.literal_error: Taking forbidden medicine is not fair …
traps.explanation_zh: 「禁藥」不是 forbidden medicine，運動上指被禁止使用的藥物：banned drugs／illegal drugs（也可說 performance-enhancing drugs）。

traps.literal_error: the prize money is higher, more people are willing …
traps.explanation_zh: 「越…越…」英文固定寫法是 the + 比較級 …, the + 比較級 …；比較級要移到各自子句的最前面，兩個 the 都不能少。

bonus.text: Doping cheats every clean competitor, yet the richer the reward, the more athletes seem willing to gamble with their careers.
bonus.explanation_zh: clean competitor（沒用藥的選手）、gamble with their careers（拿職業生涯當賭注）讓句子更有畫面；the richer the reward 用不同形容詞表達「獎金越高」。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「服用禁藥對…不公平」中文以動作當主詞，英文用動名詞片語 Taking banned drugs 當主詞；「獎金越高，就越多人…」改成 the + 比較級, the + 比較級 的固定結構，比較級移到子句最前面。

Once the truth comes out, it is very hard for these athletes to make their fans forget what they did.

虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋for 人＋不定詞（要…是非常困難的）
patterns.frame: It is + extremely difficult + for + 人 + to V …

accepted: As soon as the truth comes out

common_errors.explanation_zh: 真相是「被」揭露，用被動 is revealed；或用不及物片語 comes out。

common_errors.wrong: Once the truth will come out
common_errors.explanation_zh: once 引導的時間子句用現在式表示未來，不用 will。

accepted: for these athletes to make fans
for these athletes to make their fans
for these players to get fans to

common_errors.wrong: for these athletes to let fans forget
common_errors.right: for these athletes to make fans forget
common_errors.explanation_zh: 這裡的「讓」是「使得」，用 make／get；let 是「允許」，語意不對。

common_errors.wrong: for these athletes to make fans to forget
common_errors.right: for these athletes to make fans forget
common_errors.explanation_zh: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞，不加 to（get 才接 to forget）。

common_errors.wrong: forget the things what they have done
common_errors.explanation_zh: what 已經等於 the things that，前面不可再有先行詞。
名詞子句用直述句語序：what + 主詞 + 動詞。

common_errors.wrong: these athletes are very difficult to make fans forget
common_errors.right: it is very difficult for these athletes to make fans forget
common_errors.explanation_zh: difficult 不能以「人」當主詞表示「某人很難做某事」；要用虛主詞 It is difficult for + 人 + to V。

common_errors.wrong: it is extremely difficult that these athletes make fans forget
common_errors.right: it is extremely difficult for these athletes to make fans forget
common_errors.explanation_zh: difficult 後面用 for + 人 + to V，不接 that 子句。

traps.explanation_zh: 「真相曝光」英文說 the truth comes out／is revealed／is exposed；寫成 the truth exposes 主被動顛倒。

traps.zh: 這些選手要讓球迷忘記他們所做的事，是非常困難的
traps.literal_error: These athletes are extremely difficult to make fans forget …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「這些選手要…是很困難的」以整件事當主詞，英文 difficult 不能說「人很困難」；要用虛主詞 It is difficult for these athletes to …，把不定詞片語放到後面。

bonus.text: Once exposed, these athletes may find that no apology can ever make fans forget what they have done.
bonus.explanation_zh: Once exposed（一旦被揭發）用連接詞＋分詞，簡潔；no apology can ever …（再多道歉也無法…）語氣更強。這是加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「這些選手要讓球迷…是非常困難的」中文以人開頭，英文要改用虛主詞 It is extremely difficult for these athletes to …，真正的主詞（不定詞片語）放到後面。

1.translation: Taking banned drugs is not fair to other athletes, but the higher the prize money, the more people are willing to take this risk.
1.explanation_zh: 「服用禁藥」當主詞，用動名詞 Taking banned drugs；「對…不公平」用 not fair to；「然而」以 but 連接成一句（也可用分號＋however）；「越…就越…」用 the higher…, the more…；「冒這個險」用 take this risk。

2.translation: Once the truth is revealed, it is very difficult for these athletes to make their fans forget what they have done.
2.explanation_zh: 「一旦真相曝光」用 Once＋被動 is revealed（也可 comes out）；「…是非常困難的」用虛主詞 it is very difficult for…to；「讓球迷忘記」用使役 make…forget；「他們所做的事」用 what 名詞子句 what they have done。

issues_zh: 第 3 個參考譯文和第 1 部分 accepted 用 illegal drugs 譯「禁藥」；illegal drugs 一般指毒品（違法藥物），運動禁藥多半不是違法而是被賽事禁止，宜用 banned drugs／performance-enhancing drugs／prohibited substances。建議參考譯文改用 banned drugs，accepted 可保留 illegal drugs 但不要當範本。
